description: eBay Browse API client for official marketplace listing search, full item/product detail, prices, variations, category hints and aggregate product ratings. Requires an application OAuth token. Full review bodies/photos are not in the documented Browse response. No credentialed production replay is recorded.

capabilities.title: Acquire an eBay application access token for Browse API reads
capabilities.blocker: No eBay client ID/secret or live application token was available for this run. An anonymous request returned 403 text/html, which does not prove whether the cause is missing authorization or production access.

capabilities.title: Search fixed-price eBay listings by keyword and optional category
capabilities.blocker: The request contract and response validation are implemented, but search has not passed a credentialed live replay. The anonymous control received 403 text/html. Production Buy API access has a separate approval process.

capabilities.title: Read one purchasable listing and PRODUCT metadata by its Browse item ID
capabilities.note: The method accepts only the RESTful v1|item_id|variation_id form returned by Browse and requests fieldgroups=PRODUCT. Legacy listing ID and ePID remain distinct from the REST itemId. Live replay remains pending.

capabilities.title: Preserve full listing description and separate product description
capabilities.blocker: The listing description and PRODUCT product description are normalized locally, but no credentialed production item replay has verified them.

capabilities.title: Preserve primary and additional listing and product image URLs
capabilities.blocker: The Image object fields are normalized locally, but no credentialed production item replay has verified the gallery.

capabilities.title: Preserve ePID, GTIN, MPN, category ID path and product specification groups
capabilities.blocker: PRODUCT metadata is conditional and has no credentialed production readback for this account.

capabilities.title: Read aggregate product review count, average rating and histogram
capabilities.blocker: The official getItem PRODUCT field group exposes an optional aggregate only; no credentialed production item replay has verified it.

capabilities.title: Read current listing or auction price and currency without floating-point conversion
capabilities.note: Current fixed-price item price and currentBidPrice are separate decimal strings. Shipping costs are separate. No landed total is computed; VAT inclusion depends on marketplace and request context.

capabilities.title: Validate Browse search continuation and expose the next offset
capabilities.note: Page sizes are bounded to 1-200 and offsets to 0-9999; the response continuation URL is validated against the same query, category, fixed-price filter and page size before only its next offset is returned.

capabilities.title: Return category hints present in Browse search results
capabilities.blocker: Only categories returned by the Search response are handled. A full marketplace category tree and taxonomy traversal are not implemented.

capabilities.title: Read all variations and their per-variant prices for a multi-variation listing
capabilities.blocker: The official get_items_by_item_group endpoint, variant-price normalization and shared-description mapping are implemented locally; no credentialed production group replay has verified them.

capabilities.title: Read complete eBay product review bodies and metadata through an API
capabilities.blocker: Browse getItem exposes aggregate primaryProductReviewRating, not review records; the public web review records were observed in an HTML document, with no review-data XHR contract.

capabilities.title: Read eBay product-review photos through an API
capabilities.blocker: Neither Browse getItem nor the sampled public review XHR exposes review photo records; the sampled ePID had no visible review photo nodes.

capabilities.title: Traverse product review pages through an API with a terminal condition
capabilities.blocker: The public review pgn links navigate HTML documents; no review-data XHR pagination contract has been observed.

capabilities.title: Return an eBay Partner Network tracking URL tied to the publisher's campaign
capabilities.note: The client accepts a caller-provided 10-digit affiliateCampaignId and optional reference ID. No campaign ID is embedded in code or returned as verified.

capabilities.title: Sign in to an eBay marketplace buyer account
capabilities.applicabilityReason: This scoped capability uses an application OAuth token for public Browse reads; a buyer account login is not part of the requested catalog lookup.

capabilities.title: Place a purchase, checkout, bid, or order through eBay
capabilities.applicabilityReason: The current eBay adapter scope is product and price reads only; no purchase, checkout, bid, or order write was requested.
